acceptance: a malformed policy.json makes `evolve consensus-dispatch` report the error (test)
a comment spelling WithSignalCenter( does not satisfy the signal-center count pin (test)
fix: (1) Report the load error on stderr with a coded line and stop, or fall back loudly. (2) Absolutize through envOrCwd. (3) Count AST call expressions, not substrings. (4) Load once and write to the given console. (5) Delete the dead test or make it run.
priority_rationale: inbox review 2026-09-27: Silent policy defaults and weak count pins. The relative root is the known cycle-119 class, but the health command is run by hand.
routed_reason: operator inbox review 2026-09-30: classified ACTIONABLE-S (small, specified, re-verified against main 1e6912c4); routed to the lanes per the operator's direction to batch-implement the inbox through the evo loop
summary: Found by comment-reduction batch 44 (cmd/evolve group 2, 2026-09-26). The console verified (1). (1) cmd_consensus_dispatch.go:28 `pol, _ := policy.Load(...)` drops the error, so a malformed policy.json silently runs with the default consensus_audit_enabled. (2) cmd_cycle_health.go uses EVOLVE_PROJECT_ROOT without absolutizing it, unlike envOrCwd elsewhere (the cycle-119 relative-root class). (3) The per-file count pins in cmd_cycle_signal_center_test.go, cmd_cycle_observer_signals_test.go, cmd_inbox_signals_test.go and cmd_cycle_ledger_roots_test.go count comment text, so a comment spelling a call can hide a missing real one. (4) wireOrchestratorDeps loads policy.json three times and writes its WARNs to os.Stderr instead of the console writer it is given (08-config.md F1/F4). (5) cmd_composition_apicover_gap_test.go is permanently skipped with about 70 unreachable lines.
title: cmd/evolve: consensus dispatch swallows a policy load error; the health check uses a relative EVOLVE_PROJECT_ROOT; count pins count comment text
